issues.description: Excessive use of GO TO statements creates spaghetti code.
Hardcoded fee amounts (magic numbers) make maintenance difficult.
Fee calculation does not check if applying the fee pushes the balance further negative than intended or exceeds an overdraft limit (limit is ignored).
Unexplained and undocumented business rule for Y2K flag surcharge.
OVD-LIMIT field is present but its logic is commented out, meaning overdrafts are not enforced by the system.
Legacy code comments obscure the original intent or decision-making process.
Transaction data CSV format is inferred, may not match expected COBOL record layout exactly without proper parsing.
